8191.title: MCP elicitation never reaches the Claude provider interaction bridge
8191.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude bridge and SdkSession omit onElicitation, so the real SDK automatically returns decline without creating a bb interaction.
8191.proposedFix: Share the existing MCP form adapter through the supported SDK boundary, wire onElicitation to user-question interactions, and handle unsupported forms and cancellation explicitly.
8191.caveats: Real bridge and SDK exercised with a synthetic CLI transport, not live HTTP MCP/macOS UI. Existing suites have 5 unrelated baseline failures. No PR: safe adapter reuse crosses subsystems and requires an SDK API decision. Complete reproduction sources and exact observations are inline in the HTML; raw evidence is retained outside the public reports repository.
